stories.headline: FTSE 100 Moderately Lower As Bank, Mining Stocks Shed Ground
stories.body: (RTTNews) - The UK stock market's benchmark index FTSE 100 fell on Friday, weighed down by losses in financial and mining sectors. Worries about the impact of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East weighed as well on sentiment.

stories.headline: C&I loan growth is surging. Are private credit woes the driver?
stories.body: The recent uptick in commercial-and-industrial lending is the result of disruption in the private credit sector, one economist argues. Bank analysts say the upheaval in private credit is one factor among many.
